name: Sakurairo Prism: Beyond the Bloom
original_name: さくらいろプリズム Beyond the Bloom
source:
Spring. The photography club has been disbanded.
Hikaru Sakaki, a second-year student at Kirigamine High School in Kanagawa and president of the photography club, receives the news while rubbing his sleepy eyes.
Then, three heroines appear before him.

Aoi Kashiwagi, his childhood friend.
Mio Akashi, a playful junior.
Hatsune Suma, a mysterious ghost member.

At the end of a love that branches like light through a prism — what will Hikaru's camera capture?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4948070/]Steam[/url]]
